lessons.title: Introduce a marker word
lessons.summary: Teach your dog that a calm 'yes' (or click) always means a reward is coming, before learning new skills.

lessons.title: Build a reliable recall (basics)
lessons.summary: Start in a secure space, make coming back always worth it, and use a long line before off-lead freedom.
lessons.notes: Excluded from pilot until recall protocol human review (review-001).

lessons.title: First sit with a lure
lessons.summary: Use a treat lure, reward the moment your dog sits, then add the word 'sit' at the right time.
